verdict.rationale: The docs say skills are SKILL.md files that give the agent structured instructions for specific tasks, teaching it project-specific patterns, workflows, and constraints. Skills can be invoked explicitly via slash commands, and plugins (GitHub, Supabase, Figma) extend the agent further, so the core of the story is directly delivered. Missing for 10: detailed authoring docs (file location, format/schema, how custom skills are discovered), and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom skills working.
